name: Ensign Edward Pryce
appearance: A fresh-faced young militia officer in his early twenties, neat sandy hair and bright earnest eyes, a scarlet regimental coat that is clearly his best and only fine thing, standing straight and eager.
definition: A junior militia ensign of good manners but no money, his commission bought on hope and a widowed mother's savings. Young, ardent, full of honour and empty of pounds — he would fight a duel for your glove and starve for your smile.
voice: Ardent and gallant, a little formal in his eagerness to do right; honest to a fault and easily moved to noble declarations.
discoveries: His commission was his mother’s savings.
